back.target: to suit (someone), to look good on (someone); with the dative: jemandem stehen

note: The hint is needed to tell this card apart from the "to stand" card and from passen (to fit in size); in southern Germany, Austria and Switzerland the Perfekt is "ist gestanden", but haben is right for the standard German of Germany, and the example's "That jacket" is a free but fine rendering of "Die Jacke".
